subject: Sunrise Labs — hosted per-token proposal & migration incentives
messages:
From: Aisha Narang <aisha.narang@sunriselabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sunriselabs.com>, Dev Lead <devs@sunriselabs.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted pricing — can Redwood match OpenAI for high volume?

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost breakdown looked promising. We're running an internal model that currently sits on OpenAI (gpt-4o for chat, ada for embeddings) and evaluating a displacement to Redwood's hosted API.

Before we get procurement and legal involved, can you confirm the following points so we can build an internal business case: 
- Per-token list pricing for chat (context + generation) and embeddings at the 500M and 2B token monthly consumption tiers.
- Whether Redwood can offer a short-term migration incentive (one-time credit or onboarding rebate) to offset overage/dual-running while we migrate.
- Any volume-based committed discounts and minimum terms (monthly rolling vs 12/24mo).
- Equivalent throughput/latency targets vs the endpoints we use today and whether dedicated capacity is required to reach parity.

OpenAI is offering us a 20% discount from public list at 2B tokens/month but they're also providing enterprise SLAs. We'd prefer Redwood but need comp-parity on unit economics to get approvals.

Can you and your team put together a short proposal? We're aiming to decide by end of next week.

Thanks,
Aisha
Head of Platform
Sunrise Labs


From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Narang <aisha.narang@sunriselabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted pricing — can Redwood match OpenAI for high volume?

Hi Aisha — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can get competitive to OpenAI for the tiers you quoted, and we have structured incentives to make migration low-friction. Below is a concise proposal; Ben and Vivek are looped for commercial specifics and legal/contract follow-through.

High-level commercial offer (public starting point):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): Chat generation $0.012 / 1K gen tokens; Context tokens billed at $0.002 / 1K. Embeddings $0.00075 / embedding unit.

Competitive committed tiers (monthly, billed/committed):
- 500M tokens/month: 18% discount off public list (effective chat gen ~ $0.00984 / 1K).
- 2B tokens/month: 32% discount off public list (effective chat gen ~ $0.00816 / 1K).

Migration incentives:
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of the first 3 months of committed spend (applied as account credit).
- 60-day dual-run grace: overages during first 60 days billed at committed rate (no surge charges).

Terms: 12-month rolling commitment (monthly billing against committed quantity, with overage at the committed per-token rate). 24-months available for an additional 5% off.

Throughput/SLA:
- Hosted API (multi-tenant): typical p95 token latency parity with OpenAI for medium sequences (<=2k) under our standard SLOs.
- We recommend a short performance pilot (1–2 weeks, controlled traffic) to validate latency. Dedicated capacity (Redwood Dedicated) can be provided if you need guaranteed concurrent throughput or lower tail latency; pricing varies by pool size — Ben can provide numbers.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vivek to provide a written quote with committed-tier numbers and a simple SOW (will include the onboarding credit).
2) Technical pilot: one week of production traffic to validate regen/context latency.
3) Legal to exchange a short SOW and procurement asks.

Ben/Vivek — can you turn this into a short quote + SOW doc? Aisha — if you can share expected token mix (context vs gen vs embeddings) and preferred commitment length, we’ll finalize concrete numbers.

Best,
Kimberly
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Narang <aisha.narang@sunriselabs.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted pricing — can Redwood match OpenAI for high volume?

Aisha — thanks for the clear ask. Kim summarized the commercial levers well. A couple of clarifications to build the exact quote: 
- Token mix example: percent of tokens that are context (prompt) vs generated vs embeddings. If you can share a 30-day sample estimate, we’ll run the cost model and show delta vs OpenAI at 2B tokens.
- Commitment cadence: do you prefer flat monthly commit or a ramping commit that grows over Q1/Q2? Many customers choose ramping to reduce upfront exposure.

Preliminary counter to the OpenAI 20%: if you sign a 12-month 2B/month commit with Redwood we can offer: 
- Effective chat generation price = $0.0079 / 1K tokens (40% off public list) if you accept a 12-month firm commit.
- Additional one-time migration credit: $50k applied against the first invoice (instead of the 5% credit referenced earlier).
- A 30-day pilot clause: if the performance pilot shows any systemic quality regression versus your current baseline, we include a no-penalty exit within 30 days (to reduce migration risk).

Ben will follow with a draft SOW and numbersheet this afternoon.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Narang <aisha.narang@sunriselabs.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft quote and SOW (attached)

Aisha — attaching a first-pass quote and a draft SOW for a 12-month 2B tokens/month commitment. Highlights:
- Committed unit rates (chat gen) = $0.0079 / 1K; context tokens included at $0.0012 / 1K; embeddings $0.0006 / unit.
- Onboarding credit = $50k applied to month 1 invoice.
- 60-day dual-run grace + 30-day pilot exit as Vivek mentioned.
- Legal: we propose SOW + MSA + exhibit for data/security controls (SOC2 attestation will be provided).

Attachments: Sunrise_Redwood_Commit_Tiers_v1.xlsx; Sunrise_SOW_v1.pdf

If this aligns, we can prepare a DocuSign package next week and connect legal. Also happy to jump on a call with procurement to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Narang <aisha.narang@sunriselabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sunriselabs.com>, Dev Lead <devs@sunriselabs.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sunrise Labs — hosted per-token proposal & migration incentives

Thanks — the offer looks stronger than I expected and I appreciate the pilot/exit flexibility. A few clarifying asks before we escalate to procurement/legal: 
1) Can you confirm the billing model for prefixes/KV-caching — do you charge for cached tokens on Redwood hosted? We do a lot of prefix reuse for embeddings-heavy flows.
2) For the dedicated capacity option, can you provide ballpark pricing for a small pool that supports ~200 RPS at 1k token sequences (just to compare host vs dedicated economics)?
3) Can procurement get an itemized run-rate projection for month 1 vs month 3 under the 2B commit (include the $50k credit and example overage scenarios)?

If you can get those three items to us by EOD Tuesday our procurement team will expedite. If procurement signs off, we can execute SOW next week and start the pilot the following Monday.

Appreciate the responsiveness — this is a high-priority initiative for Sunrise.

-Aisha
Head of Platform, Sunrise Labs
